queries: WITH t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS v FROM Products), k1 AS (SELECT production_type_code, a FROM t WHERE a > (SELECT v FROM o)), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS v FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT production_type_code, a FROM k1 WHERE a > (SELECT v FROM m)) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(a - (SELECT v FROM o)) AS avg_above_overall_average, AVG(a - (SELECT v FROM m)) AS avg_above_kept_types_mean FROM k2;

WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products), type_avg AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price FROM type_avg t JOIN overall o ON t.avg_price > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_avg FROM kept), final AS (SELECT k.production_type_code, k.avg_price FROM kept k JOIN kept_mean m ON k.avg_price > m.mean_avg) SELECT AVG(f.avg_price) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(f.avg_price - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall_average, AVG(f.avg_price - m.mean_avg) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM final f CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m;

WITH type_avg AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price FROM type_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_price > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_kept FROM kept), final AS (SELECT k.production_type_code, k.avg_price FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.avg_price > m.mean_kept) SELECT AVG(f.avg_price) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(f.avg_price - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall_avg, AVG(f.avg_price - m.mean_kept) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM final f CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average price is the average of unit_price across all Products rows with a non-null price, not the mean of the per-type averages.
Types whose prices are all NULL have no average and are dropped. If no types survive both filters, the query returns one row of NULLs.

assumptions.assumption: The overall average price is the row-level AVG(unit_price) over all Products with non-null prices, not the mean of the type averages.
Types whose prices are all NULL have no average and are excluded. If no types remain, the query returns one row of NULLs.

responses.sql: WITH type_avg AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price FROM type_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_price > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_kept FROM kept), final AS (SELECT k.production_type_code, k.avg_price FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.avg_price > m.mean_kept) SELECT AVG(f.avg_price) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(f.avg_price - o.overall_avg) AS avg_above_overall_avg, AVG(f.avg_price - m.mean_kept) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM final f CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average price is the average of unit_price over all Products rows with a non-null price (a product-level average, not a mean of the type averages).
Types whose prices are all NULL have no average and are excluded. If no types survive either filter, the query returns one row of NULLs.
The mean of the kept types is the simple, unweighted mean of their type averages, as the request says.
The final 'above' differences are computed as type average minus the reference value, then averaged over the remaining types.
